purposes.search: Indexes pages for AI search answers and citations
purposes.training: Collects content to train AI models
purposes.user: Fetches a page when a person asks an AI assistant

crawlers.name: OAI-SearchBot
crawlers.note: Lets pages appear and be cited in ChatGPT search.

crawlers.name: GPTBot
crawlers.note: Collects content for training OpenAI's models.

crawlers.name: ChatGPT-User
crawlers.note: Fetches a page when a ChatGPT user asks; OpenAI says robots.txt rules may not apply.

crawlers.name: OAI-AdsBot
crawlers.note: Checks landing pages submitted as ChatGPT ads; not used for training.

crawlers.name: ClaudeBot
crawlers.note: Collects content that may be used to train Anthropic's models.

crawlers.name: Claude-SearchBot
crawlers.note: Improves search results in Claude.

crawlers.name: Claude-User
crawlers.note: Fetches pages when Claude users ask questions.

crawlers.name: Claude-Agent
crawlers.note: Anthropic-hosted browsers (including Claude Duet) acting on a user's behalf. Anthropic publishes its addresses at claude.com/.well-known/sail; check the IP, as the name is easy to fake.

crawlers.name: Googlebot
crawlers.note: Google Search index, which also feeds AI Overviews and AI Mode. Use nosnippet to limit AI features.

crawlers.name: Google-Extended
crawlers.note: Not a crawler: a robots.txt token controlling use in Gemini training and grounding. Does not affect Search.

crawlers.name: Google-Agent
crawlers.note: Agents on Google infrastructure browsing on a user's request.

crawlers.name: Google-GeminiNotebook
crawlers.note: Fetches URLs that Gemini Notebook users add as sources. Replaces Google-NotebookLM. Google says user-triggered fetchers generally ignore robots.txt.

crawlers.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
crawlers.note: Crawls requested by site owners for Vertex AI Agents.

crawlers.name: PerplexityBot
crawlers.note: Surfaces and links sites in Perplexity; not used for model training.

crawlers.name: Perplexity-User
crawlers.note: Fetches pages for a user's question; generally ignores robots.txt.

crawlers.name: Applebot
crawlers.note: Spotlight, Siri and Safari search; may also help train Apple models.

crawlers.name: Applebot-Extended
crawlers.note: Not a crawler: opts content out of Apple model training.

crawlers.name: Amazonbot
crawlers.note: Improves Amazon products; may be used to train Amazon AI models.

crawlers.name: Amzn-SearchBot
crawlers.note: Search experiences such as Alexa; not used for training.

crawlers.name: Amzn-User
crawlers.note: Live fetches for Alexa users.

crawlers.name: meta-externalagent
crawlers.note: Trains Meta AI models or indexes content for products.

crawlers.name: meta-webindexer
crawlers.note: Improves Meta AI search and cites content in Meta AI answers.

crawlers.name: meta-externalfetcher
crawlers.note: Fetches links at a user's request; may bypass robots.txt.

crawlers.name: MistralAI-Index
crawlers.note: Indexing only; not used for training.

crawlers.name: MistralAI-Training
crawlers.note: Builds training datasets; disallow in robots.txt to opt out.

crawlers.name: MistralAI-User
crawlers.note: User actions in Mistral's assistant; not used for training.

crawlers.name: DuckAssistBot
crawlers.note: Real-time fetches for DuckDuckGo's cited AI answers; not used for training.

crawlers.name: CCBot
crawlers.note: Open web archive widely used to train AI models.

crawlers.name: Bingbot
crawlers.note: Bing's index, which Microsoft Copilot answers draw on. Not re-verified on 2026-11-14 (page needs JavaScript).

crawlers.name: AI training opt-out (shared)
crawlers.note: Not a crawler: one robots.txt group that opts a site out of AI training at OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic. Anthropic has started honouring it, Microsoft from 1 Feb 2027, Google in 2027, OpenAI in the coming months. User-agent: * does not count. Draft standard announced 30 Oct 2026.
